claims.quote: Our rock-solid support to Ukraine is vital for keeping us safe here in the UK
claims.statement: UK support for Ukraine is vital for keeping the UK safe and for equipping those on the frontlines to push back Russia.

claims.quote: we are with you for as long as it takes
claims.statement: The UK is with Ukraine for as long as it takes and will go further and faster in its support.

claims.quote: Russia’s aggression cannot be allowed to succeed on our continent.
claims.statement: Russia's aggression cannot be allowed to succeed in Europe.

claims.quote: our commitment to the Ukrainian people is unshakeable
claims.statement: The UK's commitment to the Ukrainian people is unshakeable.

claims.quote: I urge partners to back the ban on Russian LNG, like we have done in the UK
claims.statement: International partners should back a ban on Russian LNG, as the UK has done.

facts.quote: Prime Minister to host President Volodymyr Zelenskyy at Downing Street today
facts.statement: The Prime Minister hosts President Zelenskyy at Downing Street on 2026-10-13.

facts.quote: The Prime Minister has also asked Ministers to draw up further sanctions, military aid, and fiscal packages to provide urgent support in the coming weeks.
facts.statement: The Prime Minister has asked Ministers to draw up further sanctions, military aid and fiscal packages.

facts.quote: The UK has already committed £1.6 billion to deliver more than 5000 LMMs to Ukraine over the next four years
facts.statement: The UK has committed £1.6 billion to deliver more than 5000 Lightweight Multirole Missiles to Ukraine over four years.

facts.quote: including delivering £45 million of surface-to-air missiles deliveries
facts.statement: The UK is delivering £45 million of surface-to-air missiles to Ukraine.

facts.quote: Chancellor John Healey will use his meetings at the IMF in Bangkok to urge partners to fully implement an equivalent ban on Russian LNG
facts.statement: Chancellor John Healey will use IMF meetings in Bangkok to urge partners to implement a ban on Russian LNG.

facts.quote: This comes after the Foreign Secretary did the same with partners at the Warsaw Security Forum yesterday [TUE].
facts.statement: The Foreign Secretary urged partners at the Warsaw Security Forum to implement a ban on Russian LNG.

mentions.name: Andy Burnham
mentions.role: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom
